name: Madibaz Fitness & Aquatics Centre
description: Promotes health and wellness for staff and students, and supports elite athletes' strength and fitness training.
cost: Sport clubs are free for students, but the Fitness & Aquatics Centre charges a membership fee. Ask the Sport office for the current amount.
contact_name: Madibaz Sport office. Gqeberha campus: 041 504 2165. George campus: 044 801 5037.

name: Using university sport facilities
description: Only registered members may use university sport facilities. Facilities must be booked in advance through the Facility Bookings Consultant. The university switchboard is +27 41 504 1111.
how_to_join:
Register as a Madibaz Sport member.
Book the facility in advance through the Facility Bookings Consultant.
contact_name: Madibaz Sport office. Gqeberha campus: 041 504 2165. George campus: 044 801 5037.

name: Athletics
description: Madibaz Athletics club. Registered Nelson Mandela University students join free of charge. Community members apply to the club and pay a membership fee that varies per club (non-refundable).
how_to_join:
Complete the Madibaz Sport registration form. You can find it on sport.mandela.ac.za, under Registration Form.
Hand the completed form to the relevant Sport Manager.
If you need a membership card, the Sport Manager can issue one.
Renew your membership every year. It is only valid for the year you register.
contact_name: Madibaz Sport office. Gqeberha campus: 041 504 2165. George campus: 044 801 5037.
